versions.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.
versions.changelog: Native-style QWERTY rows and wide Space; side tools follow one-handed layout; native Liquid Glass, removable backgrounds on every key, custom colors/opacity/spacing/height and real keyboard preview. Retains native text replacements, number row, emoji, OTP Shortcuts, Windows clipboard and direct TV typing. Host plus keyboard only.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 56 adds an opt-in app-only background location experiment for automatic screenshot copying. Enable automatic screenshot copying and full Photos access, then explicitly Start background screenshot experiment; grant location permission and optionally request Always. Shows the iOS location indicator and clear Stop control. Uses coarse location updates, saves/transmits no coordinates, and does not auto-start on app relaunch. Keeps the Photos observer active while the session runs; screenshot and location callback statuses include timestamps. Unconfirmed clipboard writes are retried when reopened. iOS may still suspend the app or reject background pasteboard operations; this is not a proven always-on screenshot service. Compilation, exact app/keyboard versions, location background mode and purpose strings were verified in the downloadable IPA. Simulator tests were not rerun; physical-device background behavior remains unverified.
